researcher_notes: Goizueta Business School's undergraduate business degree is a single major/degree: the Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA). It is not divided into multiple separate declared majors. Per the official Goizueta catalog 'Area Depths' page (this URL), every BBA student must complete at least one of five functional 'area depths' (Accounting; Finance; Information Systems and Operations Management; Marketing; Organization and Management) or an interdisciplinary depth (e.g. Business Analytics, Business and Society, Consulting, Entrepreneurship, International Business, Real Estate, Artificial Intelligence for Business) -- these are elective concentration-style requirements within the one BBA degree, not separate bachelor's programmes, so they are not recorded as separate rows here. This page is a JavaScript-rendered (Nuxt/Coursedog) catalog route that a plain HTTP fetch returns with a stale cached title for; content was verified by rendering the page in a browser and reading the live DOM text on 2026-08-22, which confirmed the BBA structure and area-depth list above. Emory College's own bulletin separately lists 'BBA + Quantitative Science (Second Major)' and Goizueta cross-lists several BBA/BA 'Concentrations' co-administered with Emory College departments (Arts Management, Business Across Disciplinary Boundaries, Environmental Management, Film and Media Management, Health Innovation) -- these are add-on second majors/concentrations layered onto an existing primary major, not standalone bachelor's degree programmes, so none are recorded as separate rows here.
evidence_excerpt: BBA AREA DEPTHS. All BBAs must complete at least one area depth. This depth may be a functional area depth or an interdisciplinary depth as outlined below. Functional area depths correspond to the five academic areas within Goizueta: Accounting, Finance, Information Systems and Operations Management, Marketing, and Organization and Management.
